purpose: Teach: マルコ/スティーブ/フィリップ/ムーア/ファーム/ヨシ/アール/服部

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがイタリア人マルコ氏のレシピを教えて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to teach you Marco's Italian recipes.
lines.style: Warm, gently informative tone. A small smile in the voice. Unhurried delivery, like sharing something pleasant she's noticed. Soft open on 'Sho.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと米国人スティーブ氏のSkypeした話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I talked with Dad about that Skype call with Steve from America!
lines.style: Bright, eager bounce to the words. Quick pace, genuine excitement barely contained. Slight breathiness on 'talked' — he wants her to know right away. Boyish pride underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフィリップ親王、つまりエディンバラ公の歴史を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's teaching you about Prince Philip—the Duke of Edinburgh's history.
lines.style: Same warm, reflective register. Slightly more measured than before, acknowledging the weight of the topic. Deliberate pause around 'Duke of Edinburgh' — she wants him to absorb it. Tender attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとロックスターのムーアさんのドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I watched a documentary about the rockstar Moore!
lines.style: Undiminished enthusiasm. Slightly faster, layering excitements on top of each other. Small gasp of delight on 'rockstar' — he's proud he gets to tell her something cool. Innocent joy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと野球のファーム見学に行かれるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's taking you to see the baseball farm.
lines.style: Warm and inclusive. A touch of conspiratorial — like she's in on the adventure too. Slow, easy pace. Slight upward lift at the end, inviting his pleasure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとゲームのヨシ、つまりヨッシーで遊んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I played with Dad and Yoshi—you know, the video game character!
lines.style: Rapid-fire, gleeful explanation. Opens bright. Quick clarification on 'Yoshi' like he's explaining something he just learned. Infectious giggle quality to the pacing. Pure boyish joy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアール、つまりRのアルファベットの書き方を教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad taught you how to write the letter R.
lines.style: Same warm, attentive tone as before. Slightly slower on 'R' — she's savoring the simplicity of it, the foundational care. Gentle completion. Like tucking in a fact.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと服部半蔵の歴史漫画を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read a manga about Hattori Hanzō—the samurai!
lines.style: Peak brightness and energy. Quick opening attack on 'Mei-sis.' Stacked excitement — both the manga AND the samurai content. Breathless quality, like he can barely keep up with his own enthusiasm. Warm closing on the samurai reveal.
